components.name: broken command airlock
components.desc: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you. This one will probably crush you.
An impossible object. Arcs flash between it and the telepad. There's a slight blue glow around it.

components.name: telescience computer
components.desc: The monitor is displaying readings from an array of sensors. They're all flashing red.

components.name: experimental telepad
components.desc: An experimental telepad, akin to cargo telepads. Something went horribly wrong with this one.

components.name: secure frezon vial crate
components.desc: A secure crate supposedly holding highly fragile vials of frezon. It's dented on the edges.

components.name: old long range fax machine
components.desc: Bluespace technologies on the application of bureaucracy. This one looks really old.

components.name: severed human arm
components.desc: There's a faint amount of blood flowing through it with no apparent source. Holy shit.

components.name: severed human head
components.desc: You swear that you can see it blinking when you look away. It still looks fresh no matter how much time passes.
It's still beating, with blood flowing out of it.
A poster advertising the 50th anniversary of this research facility - the year on this poster is 22 years ahead of now.

components.name: telepad power switch
components.desc: It's a switch for toggling power to the telepad. It's popping out of it's frame.

components.name: teleportation room substation
components.desc: Increases the voltage of electricity put into it. The chassis looks severely dented. This one doesn't look very safe...

components.name: twisted zipties
components.desc: They smell like burning plastic, yet are cold to the touch.
